tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Unified full-text search across all public GameDev.net content — forum discussions, tutorials, blogs, projects, portfolios, and game-industry news. Filter to specific kinds with content_types (e.g. ["forum_topic","forum_post"] for forums, or ["news","news_item"] for news) and order by relevance or date. Returns titles, URLs, excerpts, authors, and ids for follow-up with get_content.

content_types.description: Optional filter: forum_topic, forum_post, blog_entry, tutorial, project, portfolio, shader_project, news, news_item, answer_page, thread_digest

sort.description: Order results by relevance (default) or recency

tools.name: get_thread
tools.description: Fetch one GameDev.net forum thread with its posts (plain text), including which reply is the accepted answer.

tools.name: get_content
tools.description: Fetch the full public text of a specific item (tutorial, blog, news, project, portfolio, ShaderLab project, forum topic, canonical answer, or thread digest) using the content_type + id from a search result. Use this to ground deeply after a search. For news_item (aggregated news) this returns GameDev.net's own AI summary and enrichment with a citation link, not the source's full article text.

tools.name: list_recent
tools.description: List the most recent GameDev.net content of a given kind. Useful for "what is new" / roundup queries. Includes the curated canonical answers and "best of" thread digests.

tools.name: search_shaders
tools.description: Search public, published ShaderLab projects with structured runtime, topic, difficulty, license, and explanation filters.

query.description: Optional title, description, author, or tag search text.

topics.description: Curated slugs returned by list_shader_topics; matches confirmed techniques or equivalent author tags.

licenses.description: Only projects using one of these license keys.

explained_only.description: Only projects with annotations for the current revision.

sort.description: Relevance for text queries, publication recency, or all-time engagement.

tools.name: get_shader_project
tools.description: Fetch one public, published ShaderLab project as structured passes, channel bindings, parameters, annotations, provenance, and confirmed techniques. Source defaults to 20,000 characters and can be bounded up to 100,000.

max_source_chars.description: Maximum source characters across all passes; 0 returns pass metadata without source.

tools.name: list_shader_topics
tools.description: List the human-curated ShaderLab topic taxonomy with optional public project counts and representative examples.

include_counts.description: Include counts of public projects matched by each topic taxonomy entry.

include_examples.description: Representative public projects per topic, from 0 to 5.

tools.name: get_shader_portability_report
tools.description: Run ShaderLab deterministic E1 portability analysis for a public project and optional three.js, Godot, Unity, or WebGL target.

target.description: Optional engine target; omit for a general E1 portability report.

tools.name: list_trending_content
tools.description: What is currently trending in game-industry news on GameDev.net. mode="stories" (default) returns deduplicated multi-source story clusters (with aggregated tags, source count, and when the story broke/last updated — use get_story for the full timeline); mode="items" returns individual trending articles. Each result carries GameDev.net's owned AI summary and a source citation. Optionally filter by tag.

tools.name: get_story
tools.description: Fetch one story cluster: its AI summary and key facts, plus a source-by-source timeline of every article covering the story (each with its source and a citation link). Good for "how did this story develop / who reported it".
